source_objective: mean CE on all 512 source training samples; do not rescale lambda or learning budget

acceptance.zero_zeta_geometry: original source CE plus zero-request movement loss and execution bound; own current references; empty anchors skip

comparisons: source_batch=512 vs archived source_batch=128 within arm and seed

aggregation: within dimension, paired seed mean and sample SD, wins/ties/losses; failed runs retained and separated
